title: Better AI Answers From Sources You Trust | Bulkgrid
excerpt: Give your AI the knowledge it needs to answer with confidence. Bulkgrid turns websites and GitHub repositories into fresh, searchable context, with references you can verify.
content_html:
AI-Ready Sources

Give your AI the knowledge it needs to answer with confidence. Bulkgrid turns websites and GitHub repositories into fresh, searchable context, with references you can verify.

How it works

From source to AI-ready knowledge in minutes

Start with an indexed source or add your own. Bulkgrid turns its content into searchable knowledge, tracks changes, and makes it available to your AI.

Popular sources

Start with sources you already trust

Explore public sources and give your AI useful context in minutes.

ChatGPT

Explore ChatGPT, Codex, and ChatGPT Work documentation. This resource covers security vulnerability management, CLI usage, cloud environment configuration, automated code review, and agent customization. Access comprehensive guidance on authentication and access management. This documentation is structured for AI search and direct consumption by AI agents via MCP.

grafana.com

Explore Grafana k6 documentation, an open-source tool for load and performance testing. This resource helps AI agents troubleshoot, operate, integrate, and build resilient applications by covering browser performance, synthetic monitoring, automation, and chaos testing to prevent errors and ensure reliability.

Intro | AI coding agent built for the terminal

Explore OpenCode documentation to integrate, build, and operate your AI coding agent. Learn to configure LLM providers, create custom commands, and integrate with LSP servers, MCP tools, and ACP-compatible editors. This resource also covers secure deployment for OpenCode Enterprise, enabling AI workflows for developers.

Browse all sources

Most AI guesses. Bulkgrid Uses Real Information.

Most AI sounds confident, but often guesses. Bulkgrid uses selected and verifiable information from continuously refreshed sources so answers stay accurate.

With Bulkgrid

Answers grounded in verifiable information from your selected sources.

Ordinary AI

Answers based on broad web search, without source control over what gets used.

Product

Connect trusted sources to your AI

Index websites and GitHub repositories, track changes, and give your agents access to relevant content with references.

Use Cases

Built for Real AI Workflows

Give coding agents and AI assistants trusted context from your sources. Bulkgrid automatically tracks changes and refreshes indexed content to keep that knowledge up to date.

Coding Agents

Give your coding agent the context it needs

Bring framework documentation and private repository knowledge into your agent's workflow. Bulkgrid retrieves relevant passages from the sources you choose, with references your team can verify.

Outcome

Answers grounded in your docsPublic and private source accessLess time searching for context

AI Assistants

Ground your AI’s answers in knowledge you trust

Turn product documentation, help content, and private repository knowledge into searchable context for your AI assistants. Bulkgrid retrieves relevant passages from the sources you choose, with references users can verify.

Outcome

Answers grounded in your sourcesPublic and private knowledgeVerifiable references

Fresh Knowledge

Keep your AI’s knowledge up to date

Bulkgrid automatically checks your sources for changes and refreshes indexed content, so your AI can work with fresh knowledge.

Outcome

Automatic source refreshesTrack additions, updates, and removalsLess manual content maintenance

Stop building pipelines. Start building better AI.

Your team should be building the AI experience, not maintaining crawlers and sync jobs. Bulkgrid handles source ingestion, indexing, and refreshes so your agents can retrieve the knowledge they need.

No ingestion pipeline to build or maintain.

Developer Experience

Works With Your Stack

Use Bulkgrid with the tools you already use: TypeScript and Python SDKs, a CLI, a REST API, and MCP.

TypeScript & Python SDKs

Add source management and retrieval to your application with typed SDKs for TypeScript and Python.

MCP

Connect your AI agent to trusted sources and let it discover, search, and read relevant content.

REST API

Build source management, search, and structured extraction into your own workflows.

CLI

Manage sources and search indexed content from your terminal or scripts.

Pricing

Scalable Pricing

Every team works differently - that's why our pricing is flexible. Pick the plan that fits your workflow today and adjust anytime as your projects evolve.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about how Bulkgrid works and what it solves.
